content.short: Tensor is the fastest NFT trading platform on Solana.
content.description: Tensor offers an NFT trading experience that rivals the excitement of meme-coin markets. It provides real-time data—among the fastest on Solana—along with complete historical candlestick prices and AMM pools for NFTs. Users can sweep, bid, list, and delist NFTs in bulk, enabling high-volume operations. Built for power users, Tensor is designed to be the fastest NFT trading solution on Solana, with multi-chain support across Solana, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Ethereum, and Polygon.
